verdict.rationale: Docs confirm WHOIS redaction is free and on by default ('Cloudflare redacts WHOIS information from your domain by default,' 'offers personal data redaction on WHOIS for free'), and community first-hand reports corroborate it works automatically without action ('Contact information is redacted by default... all redacted in the whois without me taking any action', 'We do support WHOIS Privacy, free of charge'). missing for 10: no explicit confirmation that redaction applies universally across all supported TLDs/registries rather than 'if permitted by registry'.
